handoff: Diff matches #93 exactly: quick/story test check runs test:fast, ci check after open-pr (fail → implement, ci_loop 3), fix untouched, repo.test + AGENTS.md updated. test:fast and typecheck green. One minor finding: the failed-log lookup may pick a non-failing run.

findings.title: Failed-log lookup takes the branch's latest run, not the failing one
findings.detail:
`gh run list --branch … --limit 1` returns the most recent run of any workflow on the branch (e.g. the process check), which may not be the one that failed under --fail-fast; implement then gets an empty or unrelated last_check. Same in story.yaml. The script is verbatim from the issue, so not blocking.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Later: add `--status failure` (or filter by commit) to the run lookup.
